findings.title: AC#1 is not met as written: the browser spec passes against a production build of 8d8d243, because the criterion's premise is false
findings.evidence: AC#1 and failure_first require the spec to fail at /debug/concepts and /debug/state-gallery on 8d8d243. It cannot fail there. On 8d8d243 both galleries already guard themselves: ConceptsGallery.tsx:202-203 and StateGallery.tsx:353-354 return <NotFound/> when isFixtureModeAvailable() is false, and that function resolves to `import.meta.env.DEV || import.meta.env.MODE === "test"` (client-workspace-fixtures.ts:1753-1767). Both conditions are false under `vite build --mode production`. The implementer's run (/home/user/wt/ovd595-negative-control.log) shows '7 passed (22.9s)'. The evidence comment discloses this under 'Correction' and substitutes a production build of 8d8d243 with the guard forced on (ovd595-mutation-guard.log: /debug/concepts, /debug/state-gallery and the fixture panel fail; 3 failed, 4 passed). That substitute proves the spec is not vacuous. The scan half of AC#1 is met: my own grep of the 8d8d243 build finds ConceptsGallery, StateGallery and agentation markers in App-Vrz-XXFC.js. This is nonblocking because no correct spec could fail at the browser level on 8d8d243, but the acceptance criteria are binding and the implementer amended one alone.
findings.suggested_fix: The spec owner should formally amend AC#1 and failure_first to the guard-forced negative control. The #567 closeout should carry the correction into the PR body. The unit premise 'the live exposure is the two galleries' should be corrected: main already returns 404 on those routes in production, and its real exposure is shipped code (agentation plus gallery data in the 1.78 MB App chunk).

findings.title: The 'fail-closed' scan exits 0 silently when invoked through a symlinked path
findings.evidence: scripts/verify-production-bundle-exclusions.mjs:91 runs main() only when `path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`. Node realpaths the module URL but not argv[1]. My probe: via the real path, exit 1 with 'FAIL: ConceptsGallery marker ...'. Via a symlinked checkout path, exit 0 with no output, even when the dist directory does not exist. With --preserve-symlinks-main, exit 1. This contradicts the 'Missing input is a failure, never a pass' contract (lines 27-37). Hosted CI is unaffected, because the checkout path has no symlinks and the build log shows the PASS report. The same guard is used in about 20 repo scripts, so it is a repository convention, but here it guards a security gate.
findings.suggested_fix: Compare realpathSync(process.argv[1]) with realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), or move the CLI into a separate entry file with no main-module guard. Optionally make the CI step require the 'PASS:' line.

findings.title: The DevLogin marker and both gallery h1 markers can never match in a production build, so DevLogin coverage exists in name only
findings.evidence: Guidance step 2 says each marker must hit in the main build. Only 4 of 7 do. On 8d8d243, DevLogin is statically imported and routed (App.tsx:30 and :172), yet '"dev-login"' does not appear. The invoke at DevLogin.tsx:27 sits behind `if (!import.meta.env.DEV) return;` (line 15) and is removed as dead code. So neither the scan nor the spec (DevLogin renders NotFound outside DEV) would detect DevLogin re-entering a production bundle, for example through a reverted static import or an ungated lazy import that emits a DevLogin-*.js chunk. The effect is harmless today, because no dev-login code ships. The only claim that this marker ever matches is the dev-mode mutation scan in the comment, and its output is not in the saved logs: ovd595-mutation-dev.log and ovd595-mutation-guard.log contain only Playwright output.
findings.suggested_fix: Also fail on chunk file names matching ^(DevLogin|StateGallery|ConceptsGallery|AnnotationToolbar)-.*\.js$. That catches removal of the DEV gate on any of the four lazy imports, even when dead-code elimination strips the literals. Record the dev-mode scan output as evidence.

findings.title: Binding AC 1 (spec must fail at /debug/concepts and /debug/state-gallery on a production build of 8d8d243) is unmet as written because its premise is false; disclosed truthfully and substituted with stronger evidence
findings.evidence:
On 8d8d243 both galleries already return <NotFound />:
- ConceptsGallery.tsx:202-203 and StateGallery.tsx:353-354 return it when `isFixtureModeAvailable()` is false.
- client-workspace-fixtures.ts:1753-1768 defines that as `import.meta.env.DEV || import.meta.env.MODE === "test"`.
So no browser spec can fail at those routes in a production build of main. The context claim 'the live exposure is the two galleries' was wrong.
The scan half of AC 1 is independently reproduced. My clean production build of 8d8d243, with the lane's pinned env, produced App-Vrz-XXFC.js at 1,783,331 bytes, byte-identical (cmp) to the implementer's artifact. The scan exited 1 with FAIL lines for ConceptsGallery 'Sensor Bracket Ring', StateGallery 'Anonymous client landing state with intake CTA and auth entry points.', and agentation 'overdrafter-annotation-toolbar' and '--agentation-color-'.
The spec's detection power rests on the implementer's mutation runs: guard removed gave 3 failed / 4 passed, and a dev-mode build gave 7 failed. Both match the code paths I traced (DevLogin guards on DEV directly; shouldRenderAgentation returns false outside DEV, App.tsx:117-119).
The PR #567 evidence comment and the OVD-595 rolling comment both leave AC 1 unchecked as 'partly unmet as written'. Nothing is called passed falsely.
findings.suggested_fix: Have the acceptance owner explicitly record the amended negative control (the 8d8d243 scan failure plus the guard-removed mutation run of the spec) in the closeout and the PR body, rather than leaving the binding AC checkbox unchecked without an owner decision.
